backgrounds.name: FinalDestinationBrawl

A dramatic cosmic arena backdrop: deep indigo space, brilliant blue and violet nebula, distant stars and a subtle glowing horizon. Polished hand-painted environment art. Landscape 16:9. No foreground ground, no playable platforms, no characters, no lettering. 2048 pixels wide or higher.

structures.name: BattlefieldBrawl/mainstage.png
structures.prompt: Edit target: the attached game stage texture. Upgrade ONLY its rendering to polished HD videogame environment artwork with crisp material detail, smooth edges, stone/metal/grass textures as appropriate. CRITICAL: retain exact composition, all platform top edges, silhouettes, object positions and outer canvas margins. Do not add or remove structures or platforms. Preserve transparency and existing solid background colors where present. If a sprite sheet, retain exactly the same number and arrangement of frames, with identical geometry in each. Output at 2x the input resolution or higher, same aspect ratio. No text, no UI.
